hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$input" | bun -e "const d=JSON.parse(await Bun.stdin.text()); process.stdout.write(d.tool_input.command)"); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '^git push'; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/backend" && bunx --bun @biomejs/biome@1.9.4 check . --reporter=summary 2>&1; code=$?; if [ $code -ne 0 ]; then echo '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"Biome lint failed. Fix errors before pushing."}'; exit 1; fi; fi
